decisions.reason: A product line close to the core offer and featured on the home page, in a growing industry, likely meets aspirations and needs little extra slack to carry.
A traditional pyramid close to the established range that is prominently shown, so there is no shortfall signal to trigger search for alternatives.
Although distant from the core, it is presented as a flagship line on the home page, and the firm's commitment plus industry growth give it slack to carry the product through uncertain early results.
This distant accessory is only mentioned, not featured, which makes its results uncertain, but it supports the flagship music box line and is cheap to keep.
A peripheral, distant seasonal platform only mentioned on the site is the most likely to fall short of aspirations and be rationalized in favor of core products.
A themed pyramid built on core craftsmanship and featured on the home page fits established demand and likely performs satisfactorily.
